answer.reason: The verses tell of a defeat of Israel reaching to Hormah and of the place being destroyed and named Hormah.

clauses.english: was where Israel was chased and beaten by the Amalekites and Canaanites
clauses.quote: smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah

clauses.english: received its name when Israel utterly destroyed the Canaanites and their cities
clauses.quote: he called the name of the place Hormah

doubts: NUM 21:3 and JDG 1:17 may tell of different occasions of the naming; both are cited for the one naming.
JOS 12:14, JOS 15:30, JOS 19:4, 1SA 30:30 and 1CH 4:30 only list Hormah and were left out.
